description: Apply a wallpaper pattern to a single wall side at (x,y,level). Side selects which wall face (0..5; 0-3 = the four cardinal segments on a square tile, 4-5 = the two diagonal sides). Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side gate; server-side also requires BuildBuyRoommate+ via Validator.CanBuildTool). Effect: wall TopLeftPattern / TopRightPattern at the targeted side flips to `pattern` — observable via query-architecture. Cost: wallpaper price per tile is debited from lot funds by Architecture.RunCommands. Denial silent (OQ-8). Wire: VMNetArchitectureCmd { Commands: [{ Type: PATTERN_DOT, level, x, y, x2=side, pattern }] }.
call_signatures: cf $CF paint-wall --x <tile_x> --y <tile_y> --side <0..5> --pattern <pattern_id>                      # 0-3 for normal walls, 4-5 for diagonal sides
common_mistakes: side 0-3 are normal wall sides; 4-5 are diagonal sides — passing a side out of range succeeds on the wire but paints nothing visible.
perception_hints: Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — architecture ops are owner-only
Your position (to anchor where to build): perception.avatar.position.x, .y (tile coords — arch ops accept tile coords directly, unlike walk-to)
Walls/floors are NOT exposed in perception — use query-architecture (test helper) if you need pre/post state
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
required tile coords (x, y) missing → returns ok:false with '<verb> requires x, y ...'
width/height/length <= 0 where specified → returns ok:false with specific bounds error
